items.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
items.description: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.

items.title: Why has North Korea fired a missile ahead of US-South Korea drills?
items.description: Pyongyang has repeatedly condemned US–South Korea military drills, claiming they are a 'rehearsal for invasion'.

items.title: Carlo Masala, security expert: 'Germany is targeted because it is the main pillar of European support to Ukraine'
items.description: The German military analyst says the failed explosive drone attack targeting Leipzig-Halle Airport on the night of August 4 marks a turning point in Russia's hybrid war against Europe.

items.title: Deadly attack on Red Sea ship adds to global supply chain uncertainty
items.description: A strike on a merchant ship off the southern coast of Yemen that reportedly killed several seafarers on Tuesday threatens to reignite deep concerns about global trade, amid the ongoing Iran-US war that has choked shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Ukraine seeks closer cooperation with South Korea
items.description: Earlier this week, Zelenskyy accused North Korea of stepping up its support for Russia, with ballistic missiles from Pyongyang reportedly used in another deadly attack on Zaporizhzhia. Let’s get more on this from France 24’s correspondent in South Korea, Chloe Borgnon.

items.title: Ukraine Repels 185 Combat Clashes on Tuesday
items.description: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) reported 185 combat clashes over the past 24 hours, as Russian forces launched nearly 6,770 drones and 208 guided aerial bombs (KABs) nationwide.

items.title: In Ukraine, a city waits to rebuild a symbol of resistance
items.description: Instead of rushing to repair a war damaged university, policymakers decided to wait. They gained international support – and a new future.

items.title: Human rights groups sue Trump administration over ‘crippling’ ICC sanctions
items.description: Lawsuit challenges executive order targeting international criminal court for investigating Israeli crimes in PalestineFour prominent US human rights organizations have accused the Trump administration of using its “crippling” sanctions regime against the international criminal court (ICC) to undermine global efforts t…

items.title: Bulgaria drone crash a wake-up call for country's defenses
items.description: The explosion of a Ukrainian decoy drone in Bulgaria near the Romanian border reveals gaps in Bulgaria's defenses, raises questions and shines a light on the country's policy shift on the war in Ukraine.

items.title: Former Syrian President Assad sentenced to death in absentia
items.description: A Syrian court sentenced Assad along with his brother to death in absentia for crimes against humanity and war crimes during Syria's 14-year conflict that left about half a million people dead.

items.title: One Killed in Ukrainian Attack on Wildberries Logistics Center in Voronezh
items.description: The online retailer said it evacuated employees from the facility after a fire broke out during the overnight drone strikes.

items.title: Russia Reports 13 Dead After Ukrainian Drones Strike In Tatarstan
items.description: Russia said at least 13 people, including a child, were killed in Ukrainian attacks on targets in the central region of Tatarstan, one of Kyiv's deadliest single attacks since the Kremlin launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine more than four years ago.
